title: Chapter 262 The Peerless Dragon Licking
content:
Chapter 262 The Peerless Dragon Licking

"Well,"

Lu Daosheng hesitated for a moment, then said, "If it is me, I may try my best to help the entire fairy world improve their strength."

"After all, unity is strength."

The safety of the fairy world would have to be entrusted to one person.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly, then turned to look at her mother, Yan Lingyun.

"Mom, where are you?"

Yan Lingyun seemed to have expected Lu Xue to ask herself, and then smiled slightly.

"I will continue to improve myself and make myself extremely powerful, so strong that I can protect the entire fairy world with just one person's strength."

"The power of unity is important, but the only thing that can be truly trusted is yourself."

And this is Yan Lingyun's style.

In her heart, she tried not to rely on others as much as possible.

After listening to his parents' words, Lu Xue just thought for a moment, then smiled and said, "Okay, I know what to do."

To protect the world, I will finally rise.

Although I don’t know if I can do it, how can I know if I don’t try it?

Looking at Lu Xue's confident smile, Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun looked at each other and smiled.

"Xiaoxue, father and mother, look forward to your growth."

At this time, Lu Xue seemed to think of something, and then asked, "Dad, what is the enemy you are talking about? How much time does the fairy world still have now?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said, "If you have the great enemy, you will know in the future."

"As for how long it will take, emm, how long do you hope it will take?"

Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment, then secretly glanced at Lu Xue and asked.

"How long do I hope?"

Lu Xue scratched her head, then said awkwardly: "I don't even have the Immortal Lord Realm now. A genius like Sister Xiao Yin has been using it for millions of years. My words,,,."

Lu Xue looked at Lu Daosheng carefully, then stretched out three fingers.

"Three hundred thousand years? OK! Hahaha, I am worthy of being my daughter, Lu Daosheng, I just have confidence."

Lu Daosheng smiled and looked very proud.

Since my daughter is so confident, what's the point of staying there for 300,000 years?

In less than 300,000 years, the other party will not step on a hair.

Everyone in the surrounding deserted city also looked at Lu Xue with a slight respectful look.

"I am worthy of being the daughter of the city lord, and my talent is against the will of heaven."

"It's wrong to achieve the Immortal Emperor Realm for 300,000 years! It's because it's 300,000 years to be able to protect the entire fairy world. This is an explosion in the history of the entire fairy world."

"Shocked my mother for ten thousand years!"

At the corner of the square, Xiao Luo was trembling all over at this moment, which was excitement.

My goal was to achieve the Immortal Emperor Realm within 5 million years, but now, Sister Xue actually wants to reach the top of the Immortal Realm within 300,000 years.

I am still too useless.

For a time, under the influence of Lu Xue, his Taoist heart gradually began to undergo subtle changes.

On the side, Qin Feng was already confused at this moment.

Three hundred thousand years?

And it is not as simple as reaching the Immortal Emperor Realm, but it is reaching the strongest combat power in the Immortal Realm and protecting the Immortal Realm.

What the hell is this? !

Looking at Lu Xue's figure again, Qin Feng's eyes were slightly red.

"Sister Xue, I, Qin Feng, are willing to follow you for the rest of my life!"

"Same for me!"

In front of Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue's pretty face turned slightly red.

What I want to say is three million years!

What are the gazes of everyone around? !

At this moment, Lu Xue was hot all over by everyone's hot eyes, and now she couldn't explain it anymore.

At this time, Ao Qing crawled out of Lu Xue's cuffs inappropriate manner.

I saw Ao Qing's two dragon eyes already tearful.

Ao Qing choked and said, "My master, I didn't expect that your ambition was so great, and it was Ao Qing who dragged you down."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

"No, no."

However, Ao Qing shook his head, "No, little master, it's Ao Qing's useless. If I weren't as weak as I was, I'm afraid the little master would have already soared into the sky."

Speaking of this, Ao Qing looked painful.

"It's all my fault, it's all my fault that I'm too weak!"

Looking at Ao Qing's self-blame look, everyone around him moved slightly.

Unexpectedly, Ao Qing, who is beside Miss Lu Xue, also has such a side.

It seems that some rumors cannot be believed.

Unfortunately, the next moment, everyone's thoughts disappeared in an instant.

I saw that Ao Qing rubbed his arms and pounced on Lu Daosheng's feet, hugged Lu Daosheng's thighs tightly, and cried loudly, "Master, please help me quickly, I don't want to drag down the little master anymore!"

At this moment, Ao Qing's purpose was completely exposed to everyone's eyes.

The expressions on everyone's faces have long been replaced by contempt.

"This dragon licking...."

Looking at Ao Qing crying loudly while holding his thighs, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled, then lifted Ao Qing with one hand.

"What, now I know that I don't have enough strength?"

"What did you do?"

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing felt a little aggrieved: "Master, I have been working hard all the time!"

Lu Daosheng sneered.

"Haha, I think you are trying to eat and sleep."

On the side, Lu Xue nodded in agreement, "That's right, this guy knows how to eat and eat after sleep."

Lu Daosheng sighed and looked at Ao Qing for a moment.

"Okay, then I'll help you improve it. Remember, this is the last billion."

Hearing this, Ao Qing's expression suddenly lit up and he nodded repeatedly.

"Thank you, Master, you are so generous!"

Then, under the envious and jealous eyes of everyone around him, Ao Qing was stuffed into the world in his palm by Lu Daosheng.

"Okay, now, nothing is wrong."

"Everyone is separated."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and everyone immediately saluted respectfully, and then returned to their respective posts.

At the same time, Lu Xue also knew that it was time to part.

But Lu Xue didn't have any special feeling for some reason.

Perhaps, it may be because I have been with Lu Daosheng for too long.

"Dad, mom, are you going to leave this world?"

Lu Xue asked suddenly.

Hearing this question, Lu Daosheng smiled, then reached out and touched Lu Xue's head, "When you stand in the globe of the fairy world and can really stand alone, it is time for us to meet again."

On the side, Yan Lingyun also said, "Xiaoxue, your parents are waiting for you at the top of the fairy world."

Hearing this, Lu Xue suddenly felt complicated, but he nodded heavily, "Dad, mom, I will definitely not let you down."

"By the way, your two friends?"

Lu Daosheng looked at a corner of the square.

When Xiao Luo and Qin Feng saw Lu Daosheng looking at them, they couldn't help but feel shocked.

Under the eyes of Lu Daosheng and the other two, the two walked over tremblingly.

"Xiao Luo, I have met Lord Lu and Madam."

"Qin Feng, I have met the city lord and the city lord's wife."

Lu Daosheng nodded, then looked at the two of them, "You two, you guys, you shouldn't be what I thought I would?"

Lu Daosheng smiled, but his smile was a little weird.

Hearing this, the two of them shook their heads frantically and waved their hands quickly, "No, no, absolutely no!"
